The '''Starship Wastes''' was the name given to the region west of the [[Watchtower (Oricon)|Watchtower]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. The name came from the large number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that crashed in the area during the opening [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the [[Dread War]], and though the [[Dread Host]] took control of the area early on, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Strike Team Oricon]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Dread Executioners]] established [[Strike Team Oricon camp|separate]] [[Dread Executioners camp|bases]] on the western edge, and rescued many of the survivors.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Starship Wastes was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. It is the site of two faction-specific yet identical missions&mdash;"Gathering Forces" for Imperial players and "Spark of Hope" for Republic players&mdash;and the repeatable Daily version of that mission, "Fallen Forces."<ref name="TOR" />
